u01_listen1_sleep.ler: You’ll hear five short conversations between a man and a woman.
linhas: What’s the best way to fall asleep, in your opinion?
I love listening to some of my favorite songs. That helps me a lot.
But is it too loud? I mean, if I do that, I might get excited and want to dance.
No, I listen to something relaxing. That works for me.
You seem tired. Is everything okay?
I didn’t sleep well. I went to bed at 10:00, but it took me an hour and a half to fall asleep. Then I woke up at 6:00 in the morning.
Oh, no. I often make hot water with honey and lemon at night. I have that about a half hour before bed. It’s great. You should try it.
Do you do anything before you go to bed to get to sleep?
Yes, I do. I often do some reading, which helps a lot.
Oh, do you read things on your phone? I can’t sleep if I look at it before bedtime.
No, no. I don’t read on my phone, of course. I get my favorite novel and read that.
I slept really well last night. I feel terrific today.
Oh, that’s good. Did you do something different before bedtime?

Not just before going to bed. I went jogging late in the afternoon with a friend. I felt quite tired at bedtime. It usually takes me an hour to fall asleep, but last night I fell asleep in 10 minutes.
I’m having trouble getting to sleep at night.
Oh, really? Hmm. What’s the problem?
Well, I sometimes hear a text come in on my phone, then I can’t sleep.
I make sure that my phone is off when I go to sleep. I do the same thing with my laptop also.

u02_listen2_plogging.ler: You’ll hear a talk about a sport.
linhas: Many people ask me, what is plogging? To do plogging, simply go for a jog, but keep a trash bag on you. Every time you see trash, stop and pick it up, then continue jogging. Simple. The activity has become quite popular and, believe it or not, there are plogging competitions. The first world competition was in 2021 in Piedmont, Italy. It was more of a local contest, but in 2022, runners from over a dozen countries took part in that year’s competition. They even held an opening ceremony before the race began, with runners displaying the flags from their countries. So how do you win a plogging race? After the race, judges check the distance that the runner ran, but there’s more. The kind of trash they collected makes a difference in their score. If they collected a tissue paper, that’s not worth much. But if they collected a car battery, that’s quite a big score. Also, the altitude, or how high up the runner ran, matters in scoring. So a low, flat area gets a lower score than an area on a hill. Plogging is very good for the environment. In the 2023 competition in Genoa, Italy, ploggers collected an amazing 3,000 kilograms of trash. Wow!

u03_listen2_travel.ler: You’ll hear a radio show. People call in to talk about travel problems.
linhas: Welcome to the program, folks. We’re talking about travel problems. Caller, tell us your name and your problem.

Hi, I’m Cynthia. Well, I got in a taxi at rush hour in London. Big mistake. The taxi didn’t move for twenty minutes. I finally said to myself, "Walking is faster than this." I gave the driver thirty pounds and got out. Thirty pounds. What a waste.
Wow. Never take a taxi in rush hour. Okay, next caller. Say your name and problem.

Jonathan here. I was in Germany on vacation, and I took a tour on an open-air double-decker bus. It was full of tourists and great sightseeing until it started raining. They warned us about this and said to come down to the lower deck, but it was full, and we couldn’t get inside. I was completely wet in seconds.
Next time, bring an umbrella. Next caller, you’re on.

Hi, I’m Brenda. I was using the subway to get to the airport. I got in the train with my luggage, but then I stepped out again to throw an empty packet of potato chips in the trash bin. Well, the doors closed. I shouted for the driver to stop, and everyone saw me, but I guess they don’t stop once they get going.
Good luck finding your luggage. Next caller.

My name’s Denise. I heard your last caller mention airport. I was once stuck at Istanbul Airport for thirty hours, and all because of a computer error. All flights were canceled. It was awful. I was so exhausted when I started my vacation. I hardly enjoyed the first day of it.
Another reason we shouldn’t trust computers. Okay, last caller. Name and problem.

Bill here, and guess what? I haven’t got a problem. Why? Because I ride a bike. Everywhere I go, I don’t have to wait in traffic because I can use cycle paths. I get terrific exercise, and I don’t have to pay for gas. Is it exhausting? Sometimes, yes, but I prefer it to all other forms of transportation.
Thanks for training with me, Sarah. I’ve never done rock climbing, and I’ve always wanted to do it, but I’m scared of heights.

Yeah, no worries. Rock climbing is a challenging sport for many people. If you’re outside doing it, it can be scary. The rock climbing studio is much safer, and although the wall is high, there are ropes to keep you from falling. There are soft mats on the floor that help in case you do.
Can you take me through some steps before we get started?
Of course. So first, we need to check our equipment. I see you’re wearing your harness where we can connect the ropes. Does it fit around your pants okay?
And I see that you’re wearing a great pair of rock climbing shoes. So next, we have to check the ropes to see that they’re connected properly. The ropes protect us in case we fall.
Uh-oh. I’m getting a bit scared now.
That’s okay. It’s totally normal. I’m experienced, but I was once like you. After you do it the first time, you’ll find that the sport gets less and less scary.
So the next thing we must do is make sure we have chalk for our hands. The chalk will help to keep our hands dry as we climb the wall.
Then we need to look up the wall and think about what path we’re going to take. It helps to know where we’re going before we start.
And finally, if you’re new at this, you should tell yourself that you can do it. This will help us be less afraid. It’s an important step. Don’t skip it.
That actually sounds like it might be the most important step

u05_listen2_accomodation.ler: You’ll hear a man calling a campsite.
linhas: Yes, it is. How can I help you?
I just booked a place at your camping area for the weekend of the 14th. I see that it’s an eco-friendly area, and I wanted to ask about the rules.
Okay. I can help you with that. What would you like to know?
Well, my wife and I both love nature. When we visit the countryside, we collect plants to plant in our garden. Can we do that at your resort?
I’m sorry, but we don’t allow people to take plants from the area.
Oh, I see. We were also planning to bring a small wood-fired cooker. I just read on your website that you don’t allow guests to burn wood. Is that correct?
Yes, it is. We have solar-powered cookers in some locations. Did you book a place with one of those?
You can bring a gas cooker. Would that be okay?
Well, we don’t like the smell. Can I change places?
Can I put you on hold?
I’m sorry, but we’re fully booked for that type of place.
Okay. Can I cancel my booking then?
Yes, but unfortunately, there’s an extra cost to that.
Okay, that’s fine. Let’s do that then.
Would you like an email to confirm this?

u06_listen2_celebrations.ler: You’ll hear five short conversations between friends.
linhas: How did you like the dance hall?
Oh, it was excellent. Thank you for recommending it. They played beautiful music with plenty of space for traditional flamenco dancing, and everyone enjoyed themselves.
Well, I know how important music is to you. It’s a bit expensive to rent out, and the place is not in the most convenient location.
Oh, no, I didn’t mind the cost at all. I would pay even more. They played some of the best flamenco music. It reminded me of home. Some guests complained about driving so far, but I was fine with it.
Did everyone make it to the family reunion?

Oh, well, no. My uncle was away for work, and his flight was delayed due to a really bad storm. He didn’t get in until the next morning. But everyone else was there: my parents, grandparents, siblings, and my aunt and my two cousins. It was a fun afternoon.
It sounds like you had a full house.

Yeah. We had so much fun. I made a delicious tandoori chicken and naan bread with garlic butter, and everyone cleaned their plates. I mean, I love great food and entertainment, but it’s so important that the people who really matter are there to enjoy it.
You had a parade in your hometown recently, didn’t you? How was it?

Oh, it was wonderful. My company organized a group to take part in it, and I really wanted to join. They arranged a traditional samba routine, which is a dance from my home country of Brazil. They met after work to practice it, but unfortunately, I couldn’t join them because I have an art class, so I had to miss out. Anyway, there were several groups in the parade, and it was a lot of fun. I think I enjoyed it as much as my kids.
Oh, wow. Sounds like it was a great event.
Congratulations on retiring. What are your plans?
Well, a few of us are getting together on Saturday night at a Japanese restaurant in the city center. It’s important to celebrate this moment in your life with a tasty meal, don’t you think?
I totally agree, Derek. It sounds like it’ll be great fun.
Would you like to come? Our booking is at eight. I tried to get something earlier, but they’re quite busy.
I’d love to. Can Howard come? I don’t want to leave my husband home alone.
Yes, of course. I haven’t seen Howard in years. So, see you then.
What’s this I hear about a fancy dress party?

Yes. It’s Friday night. It’s a fifteenth century sort of thing. We are wearing costumes from that time period. We’re also giving a prize to the person with the most creative look: a trip for two to Thailand.
Wait, what? That’s amazing. Who’s paying for that?

Well, some of us from work were talking about it. We thought, "How could we get people to dress up for it?" My colleague, Alonzo, said, "Let’s give money for a weekend trip prize." It didn’t cost that much between all of us, about twenty dollars per person. I didn’t mind. I just wanted people to take part and really try their best.
